_comment: Single source of truth for the Go side of the LangWatchQL access model. The two ordered lists are the fixed set of source tables (each behind a per-tenant row filter) and the caller-facing views the langwatch_lwql user is granted SELECT on. They are asserted equal to the application's LWQL catalog by platform/app/src/server/analytics/lwql/catalog/__tests__/manifestParity.unit.test.ts, so a catalog change without a matching edit here fails CI. The langwatch-saas render-config.sh is a third list in another repo and cannot be checked from here.
